notes: Not automated: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When 2 or more DON!! cards on your field are returned to your DON!! deck, add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and set it as active.

abilities.text: [On Play] If the number of DON!! cards on your field is equal to or less than the number on your opponent's field, draw 1 card.

conditions.text: the number of DON!! cards on your field is equal to or less than the number on your opponent's field
